detail.longDescription: North Carolina State University: Study Suggests AI-Generated Images Could Support Conservation, but Real-World Data Remains Essential. “New research finds there is no substitute for real-world observations, but that — under the right circumstances — AI-generated images can be used to improve the performance of computer models used for species identification and biodiversity monitoring.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/10/north-carolina-state-university-study-suggests-ai-generated-images-could-support-conservation-but-real-world-data-remains-essential/
